rows.name: Proton
rows.citation: Tiesinga E. et al., CODATA 2022 recommended values, NIST

rows.name: Uranium nucleus
rows.citation: Angeli I. & Marinova K.P. (2013) Table of experimental nuclear ground state charge radii: an update. ADNDT 99, 69

rows.name: Millikan oil drop
rows.citation: Millikan R.A. (1913) On the elementary electrical charge and the Avogadro constant. Phys Rev 2, 109

rows.name: Lightning stroke (charge lowered)
rows.citation: Rakov V.A. & Uman M.A. (2003) Lightning: Physics and Effects. Cambridge University Press
rows.notes: About 5 C per return stroke; positive flashes up to hundreds of coulombs

rows.name: Earth's surface charge

rows.notes: Computed from the 100 V/m fair-weather field

rows.name: Sun's net charge
rows.citation: Neslusan L. (2001) On the global electrostatic charge of stars. A&A 372, 913
rows.notes: About 77 C: electrons escape until the star is slightly positive
